_comment: DATA-411: which silence captures pass R10 from an open draft. shown: the reply the agent sent at the ask; a row's own shown overrides it. The draft is the one `> ` quote block directly above the question on its own line (fix round 1, M2); any other shape opens nothing. shown_by: where the reply was sent (telegram: a root Telegram session; cron: a cron run; null: nothing was shown). resident_turn: the resident sent any message after the ask (it closes every open ask). age_s: seconds between the ask and the capture (at least SILENCE_PUBLISH_MIN_AGE_MINUTES = 30 min = 1800 s, at most SILENCE_PUBLISH_WINDOW_HOURS = 24 h = 86400 s). session: where the capture is made (cron: a cron run seen on platform cron; cron_prefix_only: a cron_ id never seen on platform cron; unknown: a session never seen; telegram: the resident's chat). marker: confirmed_in_chat, or null. text: the capture's exact text. expect: published (source message, publish_via open_draft) or the held code, which is exactly what the tool answered before DATA-411. Checked by plugins/av-events/tests/test_silence_publish.py.
